go nuts

Eat out with a nut allergy, without the guesswork

Elise Lehman · MGT 409 Final Project · October 2026

App: go-nuts-mepgzkf6appmyn8z3rqm8ts.streamlit.app · Code: github.com/elehman28/go-nuts

The problem

Every meal out starts with homework

  • I have a nut allergy, and so do some of my family. We read every menu, guess at sauces, and call ahead.
  • 10.8% of US adults have a food allergy; 1.8% peanut, 1.2% tree nut [JAMA Netw Open 2019]
  • Only 33% of servers had any food-allergy training [CDC MMWR 2017]
  • 28% of US food-allergy deaths were linked to food establishments [Rotella & Oriel 2022]

"This site gives us more reassurance before getting to the restaurant, so we can focus on spending time with each other, not on whether what we're eating contains nuts."

Safety

Real risks, built defenses

  • Attacks: prompt injection removed before the AI sees it (shown); web text escaped; javascript: links blocked
  • Malfunction: every rating quotes the menu; misreads caught (Domino's chart: a second symbol we nearly missed)
  • Overspending: 150K/session and 2M/day budgets, 90 s timeouts, capped loops
  • Privacy: no accounts; profile stays on your device; no people in photos; anonymous, consented feedback
  • 83 automated tests, free to run
